metadata.title: Best AMRITSARI KULCHA in Gurgaon I Eating Punjabi SPL dishes & Shopping Badam Modak with  @magicpin1891
metadata.description:
#Advertisement
Magicpin Website: https://magicpin.in/
Download the Magicpin App here:
https://tinyurl.com/2w4sszjt

We all look forward to discounts during any kind of purchase so when India's no.1 Savings App Magicpin approached us to try their platform for a wide range of expenditures, we decided to give it a try. No points for guessing that we opted for food related expenditure to test their claims.

Since this collaboration came in the midst of our future food tour planning with the dynamic travel vlogger Khusboo Barry from Gurugram, we decided to embark on a mini food exploration with her in Gurugram to see how much do we save by ordering or paying through Magicpin.

For this we went to two of Khushboo's favourite spots in the city. One was Bikanerwala in sector 54 and the other was Kulcha Kulture in Sector 14, Huda Market. In the first spot we polished off some rajma chawal and chole bhature and also purchased some badam modak for home through Magicpin. We got a discount of 20 percent on the total bill in the form of Magic Points. Moreover, the payment procedure through the app was so easy and quick.

Next we went to Kulcha Kulture for their much appreciated Amritsari Kulcha platter. From their eclectic menu we chose the Kandhari and the classic aloo pyaaz Kulcha options. Both of them were unbelievably good. And the best part was by paying for it through Magicpin we got a discount of 29 percent on the total bill amount in the form of Magic Points.

With all those savings we had a good time exploring some delicious flavours from Gurugram.



ABOUT MAGICPIN
Magicpin is India’s #1 Savings App with 5 million+ users in Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Goa, Chennai, Ahmedabad, Kolkata & quickly spreading to more cities and countries. Here’s how it works: Each time you shop, you earn. Upload your bills to magicpin, and get magicPoints in return. Use those magicPoints to get online and offline deals, and major discounts on India’s biggest brands, across food, fashion, beauty, grocery, spa, fitness and more. 1 magicPoint is equivalent to 1 Rupee. 

Try out the app using our code 'delhifoodwalks' because as a first-time user downloading the magicpin app, you get 400 magicPoints with 200 bonus magicPoints with the above code. Grab your chance to get a total of 400 rupees worth of magicPoints. The offer is valid only for the first 500 people.

On McD, Wow Momo, Faasos, Behrouz Biryani, CCD- 90% upto. Rs 125 on first food offer. Use our code 'delhifoodwalks' to avail the same

There's also 40 % to 50 % on many other brands and outlets. 


About the host - Anubhav Sapra
https://www.instagram.com/anubhav.sapra/
 
Anubhav Sapra is an avid culinary explorer who loves to travel and explore different cuisines primarily the street food, not just for the sake of gustatory pleasure but also for quenching his deep thirst for nurturing new cultural connections through the kaleidoscopic canvas of food. He believes that the vibrant and delectable street food tradition across the globe has the power to bring communities together and foster harmonious human existence.
 
Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! 

Thank you for watching!
